summary: Root owns complete recovery and Home/Root/stage integration joins while component contributions retain disjoint touch-sets; Home retains durable baseline custody and same-PR adoption. Select the actual allocation mechanism and accountable owner before an issuer or wrapper whose proof depends on it; an unresolved bootstrap cycle remains a supplier gap. The first meaningful joined test follows the actual production entry through launch, the real reservation interface, sealed input, execution and collection. Substitute only genuine external boundaries: replacing an internal production role proves a component seam, not runtime readiness. Compose receiver identities, wrappers, source/tool pins, lifetimes and cleanup early; freeze one candidate for one independent existing-PR review. Preserve first failures, Unknowns, actual private successor custody outside managed/disposable roots, original receipts and the running caller pin. Missing enrollment fences board selection while independently authorized source and separately qualified Status work retain their guards; isolated cache repair preserves locks and the first content-hash failure. Reconcile current owning issues without another ledger. For non-functional prose use citation/link/archive and existing protected checks; keep unchanged advisory-format failures visible without forcing unrelated repair. Explicitly fetch unavailable immutable Git objects and verify exact bytes/hashes before claiming path absence; an unfetched or unavailable object is a retrieval gap, not a citation defect. This supersedes the earlier integration guidance without adding gates, ordinary-Git packets, review chains, runtime authority or measured savings. Source delivery does not establish publication, installed adoption or native acceptance.
title: Use actual allocation and production interfaces with verified source evidence
